scores.note: One island society organised rice farming around shared water for a millennium, with few outside descendants; scores imply tier 2, below the reviewed tier 1.
One spring's irrigation use attested by one inscription, serving a local community with no known successors.
Storable freeze-dried potato fed most Andean highland societies for generations and enabled long-term stores, with few later techniques resting on it.
Made maize a nourishing staple across Mesoamerica for generations, the document's own reach 2 case, with later masa foods as its successors.
A better pressing step used by many lowland South American and Caribbean societies, with nothing later known to rest on it; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
Gave heart-block patients, a small share of humanity, permanent pacing and started the line of implanted cardiac rhythm devices.
The encoding scheme that made MRI robust and became standard, so routine hospital MRI across many societies and later pulse sequences descend from it.
First soft-tissue cross-sections of living patients, now routine hospital care across many societies, and the start of computed tomographic imaging as a field.
The Glasgow scanner founded clinical obstetric and abdominal ultrasound, now routine in pregnancy care across many societies, though this configuration was itself superseded.
Listening to the chest became a new diagnostic ability used by physicians across many societies and founded physical diagnosis; implies tier 1, above the narrower-scope reviewed tier 2.
Seeing inside the living body was a new capability that spread to hospitals across many societies and founded radiology, though much of humanity still lacks access.
A better selective plate used by some bacteriologists that kept the mould strain in circulation; scores imply tier 2, below the reviewed tier 1.
Turned cumbersome oximetry into continuous routine monitoring that anaesthesia and hospital care across many societies reorganised around, with later sensors as direct successors.
Koch's proof seeded bacteriology, whose diagnosis, hygiene and therapy reached most of humanity and many fields, though it is one cornerstone of germ theory.
A more scalable insulin source for insulin-treated diabetics, a small share of humanity, followed by analogue insulins; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
One hospital trial on a handful of patients that showed systemic infection could be cured and launched penicillin therapy; as an instance it implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
Gave immunologists and clinical laboratories the new ability to tell human T-cell subsets apart, from which immunophenotyping and antibody therapy lines grew.
Vaccination reached most of humanity, is the document's depth 2 case, and became the platform for immunology, vaccines and disease eradication over generations.
One field deployment by a few teams that sped outbreak genome reading and from which real-time genomic epidemic surveillance grew.
Preventing wound infection made surgery survivable across many societies and founded antiseptic then aseptic surgery; implies tier 1, above the narrower-scope reviewed tier 2.
Changed what many societies take living things and humanity to be, the document's depth 3 case, and underlies biology, ecology and medicine over generations.
One diffraction study giving structural biologists more exact helix dimensions, with the double-helix model as its direct successor; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
Reorganised DNA sequencing for one profession and is the document's own generativity 2 example, so scores imply tier 1, not the reviewed tier 0.
An independent route that let molecular biologists read DNA, widely used for a decade then superseded with few descendants; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
Explained how genes are copied and became the platform for molecular biology, whose medicines, tests and crops later reached many societies.
A laboratory reagent for one profession that made test-tube DNA synthesis possible and underlies sequencing, amplification and cloning; reach 1 implies tier 1, not reviewed tier 0.
Simplified already-automated four-colour sequencing to one tube and became genome-production chemistry; the reorganising step was the earlier primer readout, so implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
First turned DNA sequencing into a machine-read, computer-called activity for one profession, and automated sequencers and genome production grew from it.
One study among several parallel CRISPR screens, refining knowledge of essential genes with a few follow-on reference sets; implies tier 3, below reviewed tier 2.
One dataset that gave biomedical researchers genome-wide lookup and became a platform for many fields; reach of one profession implies tier 1, not reviewed tier 0.
A scaled-up strategy used by genome centres from which the human reference genome line grew before being superseded; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
Used mainly in one laboratory, it first allowed rapid reading of long DNA and began the primed-synthesis sequencing line that chain termination continued.
Scored as described, the laboratory technique of propagating and expressing foreign DNA in bacteria, a new ability for one profession that began recombinant protein production.
Experimental confirmation for molecular biologists that an enzyme copies DNA by base pairing, on which primed-synthesis methods rest; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
One laboratory's analyses extending known base-ratio regularities to insect viruses, cited by the double-helix model; implies tier 3, below reviewed tier 2.
One genome sequence that showed molecular biologists overlapping genes and whole-genome reading at work, with later genome reports as direct successors.
Automatic cutting of complex contours was a new capability for manufacturing trades across societies, and numerically controlled machining and computer-aided manufacture grew from it.
A better-holding point geometry in a Central African tradition, with later regional barbed points as plausible successors and wider descent unproven; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
A new launching architecture that reorganised hunting for many forager societies over millennia, with darts as successors and common descent across continents unproven.
More exact cylinder boring for the engine-building trade, on which Watt engines and heavy precision machining rested; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
One workshop lathe giving more exact, repeatable threads, whose architecture passed through Maudslay's pupils into the machine-tool line; as an instance implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
One surviving machine that mechanised a single step in one dockyard's block production, with nothing later known to rest on it.
One engine re-tasked to drive tools in one workshop, a local improvement with no later work shown to descend from it.
One better-machined replacement cylinder for one experimental engine, with the Soho engine trials as its direct successor.
One dockyard reorganised block-making around sequenced special-purpose machines, with few proven descendants in later mass production; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
One described design improving animal-powered water lifting, with no later machine shown to rest on it; implies tier 3, below reviewed tier 2.
One site scaling up existing watermilling for one city, later abandoned with no known descendants; implies tier 3, below reviewed tier 2.
One workshop witnessing cheaper stone sawing by water power, with no later work shown to depend on it; implies tier 3, below reviewed tier 2.
One workshop witnessing water-powered stone sawing, whose listed link is a shared-concept sequence rather than shown dependence; implies tier 3, below reviewed tier 2.
One relief witnessing a water-powered saw that existed anyway, with later saws not shown to depend on this one; implies tier 3, below reviewed tier 2.
A siege-time debris barrier for one city's boat mills, a small protective refinement with nothing later known to rest on it.
